summary: Frontend-only testing of isDark bug fix, OI panel positioning fix, and chart lines feature. All 9 test scenarios passed: app loads without crash, chart renders, OI button exists right of REJ, panel opens right-aligned without cutoff, panel shows all required data fields, Lines ON/OFF toggle works, chart price lines drawn, REJ regression pass, backdrop close works.
critical_code_review_comments: MINOR: In oiLinesOn useEffect (line 2748), `candlestickSeriesRef.current.markers?.()` uses optional chaining on a non-existent method (lightweight-charts v4.2.1 removed `markers()` getter). The fallback `|| []` means direction-change markers always start fresh (cannot merge with existing markers). This is non-critical since the try/catch silences errors and lines still draw. However, OI direction arrows may conflict with other indicator markers. Not blocking.
INFO: When OI button is clicked, oiLinesOn is auto-set to true (lines always drawn on first click). This is by design per the onClick handler at line 3489.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 44: All OI-related features verified working. isDark fix confirmed at line 1357 (const isDark = theme !== 'light'). OI button at x=820, REJ at x=778 (correct order). OI panel: right-aligned (right:0), width=300, left=550, right=850 - not cut off in 1920px viewport. Panel shows: signal (SHORT COVERING), PCR (0.733 NEUTRAL), Max Pain (24500), Call Wall (24500 Resistance), Put Wall (24200 Support), 7 strike OI bars. Lines toggle: 'Lines ON'/'Lines OFF' toggle works. Chart price lines: Max Pain (yellow), Call Wall (red), Put Wall (green) drawn. Backdrop click closes panel. No JS console errors (only WebSocket warnings expected in preview env). OI API endpoint /api/oi-indicator/nifty working, returns real NSE data.
